purpose: Gate 1 for the operating-point curvature: the Gauss-Newton probes of A + lambda Z + beta K linearized at each host's own W2 model (the A16 baselines' H_U weights) instead of at BF16. Phase 1 at BF16: 6.9% of the A head goes through the future and beta K carries 1.2% of the mass, while at W2 the BF16-future swap removes 44-61% of the held-out first10 motor MSE; on every host the phase-1 H~ raised both the held-out mixed loss and the future share of the motor MSE.

probes.contexts: C80, sampler seed index 0, the host's W2 weights installed in all 614 target Linears
probes.A: executed action: the model's own (W2) prefill + action loop from the query's future, as in phase 1
probes.K: frozen BF16 reader (the 614 BF16 masters, same biases) on the student's own future z_hat; c_K = J^T g_K with g_K = Rademacher * sqrt(h/2), h the soft-bin KL curvature at the teacher action; computed in a separate pass before the probe pass, without the query graph
probes.Z: Rademacher / |z_T[:,:,1:]| on future[:,:,1:], as in phase 1
probes.generators: A and Z cotangents from protocol probes.seed + case (A then Z per probe), K from k_seed + case

selection.damage: per layer sigma_l^2 * mass_l: sigma_l^2 = mean squared error of the host's baseline W2 weight, mass_l = sum over calls and heads of sum_t u_t |x_t|^2 at the operating point, C80 mean (isotropic rounding noise: E[(g . dW x)^2] = sigma^2 |g|^2 |x|^2)
selection.same_layers: the G and O arms of a host replace the same layers

hessian: H~_op = sum_t (u_t / ubar_l + gamma) x_t x_t^T / sum_t (u_t / ubar_l + gamma), phase-1 form and gamma (protocol hessian.gamma); u and x from the operating-point probes and a replay of the C80 queries with the host's W2 weights installed

arms.U: the host's baseline W2 (held-out from phases 1 and 3)
arms.G: GATE_<host>_G: baseline W2 with the selected layers taken from the phase-1 H~ arm (BF16 linearization point)
arms.O: GATE_<host>_O: baseline W2 with the selected layers requantized by the host on H~_op, baseline seeds

decision.rule: go to the full run if on at least min_hosts hosts the O arm lowers both the held-out mixed loss and the future share of the first10 motor MSE (1 - mse_swap / mse) against U
decision.reported: the same two quantities for the G arm, the head shares at both linearization points, ESS over contexts

allocation.ncpus_basis: one probe / replay / quant / eval process per GPU, ~3 busy cores each (26043905 CPU_SAMPLE); PBS sets 16 per GPU on g2 regardless
allocation.memory_basis: per process: runtime + 614 BF16 masters on the CPU (~9 GB) + the C80 probe statistics during the replay

steps: probe (2 GPUs, contexts split): per host install the baseline W2, sigma (shard 0), K pass, probe pass -> results/gate/<host>/{sigma.json, kpass/, stats/}
select (1): damage, top layers, head shares at both points, ESS -> results/gate/selection.json
hessian (2, layers split): H~_op of the selected layers -> results/gate/<host>/hessians/
quant (2): the host on H~_op for the selected layers -> results/gate/<host>/{weights, wstats}/
eval (2): held-out 40x2 + swap of the six GATE arms -> results/heldout/GATE_*.json

full.purpose: Submitted only on DECISION go: H~_op of all 614 layers per host, every layer requantized by the host on it with the baseline seeds (the gate's selected layers reused bitwise: same H~_op, seed and code), held-out 40x2 and LIBERO-Plus 280 of the three O arms; per host against the baseline (H_U) and the phase-1 H~ arm, paired McNemar, pooled over the hosts.

allocation.ncpus_basis: 8 loop workers ~2 cores each, quant ~1 per GPU (26043905 / 26050310 CPU_SAMPLE); PBS sets 16 per GPU regardless
allocation.time_basis: replay ~10 min per host on 2 GPUs (26043905); host quantization 1.86 + 3.84 + 1.28 GPU-h (A16 baselines) / 4; closed loop ~40 min per arm on 4 GPUs

steps: full_hessian (4): H~_op of the remaining layers per host -> results/gate/<host>/hessians/
full_quant (4): every (host, layer) on H~_op -> results/quantized/<host>_O_W2/{weights, stats}/
full_eval (4): held-out 40x2 + swap of the O arms
loop: LIBERO-Plus 280 of each O arm, 8 workers
